desc: Precompute inverses and factorials up to N modulo 998244353.
Compute digit counts and sums for each length d (1 to 6).
Compute v_d = (10^d − 1) mod MOD for each d.
Build the base polynomial (1 + v_d t)^{cnt[d]} for each d with cnt[d] > 0 using binomial expansion.
Multiply all base polynomials using NTT to obtain P(t) of degree N.
For each d, compute the coefficients of H_d(t) = P(t) / (1 + v_d t) via the recurrence h_k = p_k − v_d h_{k−1}.
Compute the integral I_d = ∑_{k=0}^{N−1} h_k · inv[k+1] mod MOD.
Combine: total = N! · ∑_d S_d · I_d mod MOD, then output.
